answer: Every miner stakes an onyx token bond, 500 minimum, locked before claiming work. Each solved proof burns 2 umber units from that bond; failed audits burn 40. To fake 10,000 identities you must lock 5 million onyx and pre-fund 20,000 umber for the burn, roughly $340,000 at current rates, plus around 900 GPU-hours monthly to keep the fabricated proofs flowing. Honest nodes recover stakes after 30 days. The marble ledger records every burn permanently, so a sybil farm bleeds real capital on each fabricated proof until the bond empties and the identity dies.
